third_party_evaluations.summary: First industry credential for auditing cloud computing systems; joint ISACA/CSA.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced specialty: 3. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Joint ISACA/CSA recognition supports a focused cloud-audit specialization layered onto assurance work; the explicit narrow use case makes general seniority less informative than the recorded specialty hint.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Joint ISACA/CSA cloud-auditing coverage is a focused assurance specialty built beside cloud or audit practice. Proctoring and a two-year profile help, but the narrow use case does not establish general security seniority.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded joint ISACA and CSA cloud-audit credential addresses a specific assurance branch. Its explicitly narrow use case fits specialty rather than implying higher general cloud-engineering seniority.
